name: ToastObject
description: Options of one toast, passed to `add`, `update`, and `promise` of `useToastManager` or a `toastManager`.

props.name: id
props.description: Unique identifier of the toast. Generated when omitted.

props.name: colorPalette
props.description: Color palette of the toast. Also picks the default icon.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon shown in the toast. Replaces the default icon of `colorPalette`.

props.name: close
props.description: Whether to show the close button.

props.name: actionProps
props.description: Props of the action button, such as `children` and `onClick`. Also takes the `colorPalette`, `size`, and `variant` of Button; `colorPalette` defaults to `secondary`. The action button is shown only when this is set.

props.name: timeout
props.description: Time in milliseconds before the toast closes on its own. `0` keeps it open until closed.

props.name: priority
props.description: How urgently assistive technology announces the toast. `low` waits for the current speech to end; `high` interrupts it.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called when the toast is closed.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Called when the toast is removed after its closing animation completes.

props.name: data
props.description: Custom data for the toast. Its type is the `Data` type parameter of `add`.
